Ba2H2 (reduced formula BaH) crystallizes in the triclinic space group P1, with four atoms per unit cell distributed over four independent Wyckoff orbits. Geometry-only CrystalNN analysis gives both Ba and H centers a close-packed-like local arrangement with 12 geometric neighbors each; Ba environments include 9 Ba and 3 H neighbors or 6 Ba and 6 H neighbors, while H environments involve 3 Ba and 9 H neighbors. The geometric neighbor graph forms a single 3-periodic component spanning all four sites. Validated polyhedron-sharing relations between 12-vertex Ba and H coordination polyhedra include corner-, edge-, and face-sharing contacts.
